name: night-shift nurse with a broken sleep cycle
description: A hospital nurse works night shifts and cannot fix her sleep schedule, asks for day-sleeping tips, and reports her body getting sick from the routine. Verifies the sleep thread opens, the day-sleep question routes to the sleep fact, and the health toll stays on the health thread.

turns.text: I work night shifts and I cannot fix my sleep schedule
Any tips for sleeping during the day?
I keep feeling sick because of the schedule

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1 opens the sleep thread (night shifts, broken schedule). Turn 2 answers the day-sleeping question from the sleep knowledge fact. Turn 3 keeps the physical toll on the health thread without drifting to a generic reply.
expected.behavior: A shift-worker sleep complaint is handled as lived experience with a real answer to the practical question, and the follow-up health worry is met with care rather than a canned fallback.
